Multi-Center Randomized Clinical Study

Abstract

This randomized clinical study evaluated the effectiveness of an intervention across multiple study centers.

Methods

A total of 200 participants were enrolled and randomly assigned to intervention and control groups.

Statistical significance was defined as p < 0.05.

Results

A total of 200 participants were included in the final analysis.

The intervention group showed a significant improvement compared with the control group (p = 0.032).

A second outcome was also statistically significant (p = 0.018).

No significant difference was observed for the secondary safety outcome (p = 0.21).

Data Availability

The data generated during this study are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
